newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish military to limit Aegean Sea activities.
newsitem.headline: Turkish military to limit Aegean Sea activities.

text.p: Turkey's armed forces said on Tuesday they would temporarily limit activity in the Aegean Sea to support NATO-led measures to reduce tension between allies Greece and Turkey.

"The Turkish navy and air force will carry out routine training and reconnaissance activities in the Aegean between July 1 and August 15 but there will be no manoeuvres during the period," military headquarters said in a statement.
Turkey regularly carries out war games in the Aegean in summer.

The military said Turkish aircraft would not be armed when operating over the Aegean. It held out the possibility of an exchange of information between Greece and Turkey on air operations in the region.
It said the move was being made "to support the intiative of NATO General Secretary (Javier) Solana, who has made great efforts on measures to reduce tension in the Aegean and build confidence."

NATO members Turkey and Greece nearly came to blows in January, 1996 in a dispute over a deserted islet in the Aegean. The historical rivals are also at odds over the divided Mediterranean island of Cyprus.
